data.description:
## Incident Overview

### Scenario
When a PreToolUse hook fires a 'BLOCKED' message, the error string surfaced to the agent contains the literal token '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}' rather than the resolved plugin path.

### Example (observed during /dso:debug-everything session 2026-05-08)
```
PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run-hook.sh dispatchers/pre-bash.sh]: BLOCKED: Bash mkdir targeting main repo from worktree session.
```

### Expected Behavior
The hook identifier shown in the error should be a path the agent can act on — either fully resolved (e.g., '/Users/joeoakhart/.claude/plugins/cache/digital-service-orchestra/dso-dev/1.16.11/hooks/run-hook.sh') or a stable shorthand. Verbatim '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}' provides no actionable location.

### Actual Behavior
Literal '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run-hook.sh' appears in the user-facing error string. The variable was not expanded by the layer that constructed the error.

### Suspected Root Cause
The hook configuration in settings.json references hook commands with the unexpanded variable. The error-message constructor uses the raw command string from settings.json instead of the resolved/expanded form. The fix is most likely in the agent-side error formatter (claude-code harness) rather than in the DSO plugin — DSO's hook scripts only contribute the body of the message, not the bracketed prefix.

### Severity
P4: cosmetic. Does not affect correctness; only impacts error message readability and agent self-debugging.

### Reproduction
1. Trigger any DSO PreToolUse hook block (e.g., `mkdir` command from a worktree session targeting main repo).
2. Inspect the resulting tool error string returned to the agent.
3. Observe the literal '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}' in the bracketed prefix.

### Files Likely Involved
- claude-code harness error formatter (out of repo) — most likely site
- .claude/settings.json hook configurations (where the unexpanded reference originates)

### CLI_user
Reported by human user during interactive /dso:debug-everything session 2026-05-08.
data.title: [claude-code hook error formatter]: hook blocks Bash with literal '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}' in user-facing error -> unexpanded variable confuses error attribution
